face_benchmark_accuracy.description: Paper Table 3: AdaFace-IResNet101 face verification/identification accuracy with and without IDFace.

lfw_accuracy.description: Context-only paper verification accuracy on LFW; not scored by the portable local gym.

cfp_fp_accuracy.description: Context-only paper verification accuracy on CFP-FP; not scored by the portable local gym.

agedb_accuracy.description: Context-only paper verification accuracy on AgeDB; not scored by the portable local gym.

ijbc_verification_tar_fpr_1e-3.description: Context-only paper IJB-C verification TAR at FPR 1e-3; not scored by the portable local gym.

ijbc_identification_tpir_fpir_1e-2.description: Context-only paper IJB-C identification TPIR at FPIR 1e-2; not scored by the portable local gym.

ijbc_identification_tpir_fpir_1e-3.description: Context-only paper IJB-C identification TPIR at FPIR 1e-3; not scored by the portable local gym.

ijbc_identification_tpir_fpir_1e-4.description: Context-only paper IJB-C identification TPIR at FPIR 1e-4; not scored by the portable local gym.

efficiency_1m.description: Paper Table 2 and Table 1: 1M-identity identification efficiency and operation counts.

identify_seconds.description: Context-only paper wall-clock identification time retained only so reported paper rows validate; it is not scored by the portable local gym.

storage_gb.description: Context-only paper storage footprint for 1M identities; not scored by the portable local gym.

ciphertext_multiplications_per_query.description: Context-only paper count of encrypted multiplications per query; the portable gym scores its own artifact metadata instead.

ciphertext_rotations_per_query.description: Context-only paper count of encrypted rotations per query; the portable gym scores its own artifact metadata instead.

synthetic_identification.description: Portable reproduction benchmark: unit-vector biometric identification on generated embeddings.
synthetic_identification.notes: This experiment is the local reusable gym benchmark because the original face datasets and full embedding pipeline are not bundled. Reference rows are target/anchor values for the generated benchmark, not paper-published results; the paper-published context values are retained in the zero-weight face_benchmark_accuracy and efficiency_1m experiments.

top1_identification.description: Closed-set fraction of genuine queries whose highest-scoring gallery entry has the true identity.

mean_reciprocal_rank.description: Average reciprocal rank of the true identity, rewarding methods that preserve ranking quality beyond exact top-1 wins.

tpir_at_fpir_0.1.description: Open-set true positive identification rate after setting the accept threshold to 10% false-positive identification rate on impostor queries.

tpir_at_fpir_0.01.description: Primary open-set identification metric at 1% false-positive identification rate.

tpir_at_fpir_0.001.description: Stricter tail open-set identification metric that catches methods tuned only to the visible 1% threshold.

mean_genuine_rank_margin.description: Average score gap between the true enrolled identity and the best wrong identity on genuine queries; larger margins catch fragile rank-only shortcuts.

open_set_score_auc.description: Threshold-independent probability that a genuine true-identity score exceeds an impostor query's strongest gallery score.

ciphertext_additions_per_query.description: Machine-independent encrypted additions required per query; missing non-baseline metadata is scored conservatively.

ciphertext_multiplications_per_query.description: Machine-independent protected-domain multiplications required per query; lower is better because these operations are substantially more expensive than additions.

ciphertext_rotations_per_query.description: Machine-independent encrypted rotations required per query.

decryptions_per_query.description: Number of decryptions required per query.

pack.description: Number of protected templates packed per plaintext slot, rewarding space-efficient encoding.

protected_template_storage.description: Whether enrolled templates are stored in a protected representation rather than as reusable raw unit vectors.
